title: Sound
subtitle: Core sound: voice sessions & realtime talk, voice identities, transcripts, TTS & ASR
noProviders: No providers (register FunASR etc. to enable)
analyzeHint: Transcribe an audio file from the upload dir (workspace/uploads/) into the internal library
voiceHint: Endpointing and segmentation parameters for realtime voice sessions (hot-applied)

timeline.empty: No voice records in this range
timeline.emptyHint: Try another range, or wait for directory sync to ingest new recordings

empty.speakersHint: Wait for upstream voiceprints, or enroll a known speaker at top right
empty.segmentsHint: Adjust filters, or wait for the upstream pipeline to push segments
empty.recordingsHint: Enable directory sync in Settings and configure the NAS audio directory; new recordings will be ingested automatically

modals.mergeHint: The source speaker's sample pool, transcripts and stats will be merged into the target; the source profile will be deleted.
modals.enrollHint: Upload clear speech of this speaker; a voiceprint will be extracted via FunASR.
modals.editTranscriptHint: Semantic vectors are rebuilt after saving; for batch fixes ask AI to run transcript_replace.
modals.deleteHint: This cascades: deletes {{key}} with its voiceprint samples AND all its segments. To keep the segments, use Merge instead. This cannot be undone.
modals.pruneHint: This cascades: prunes {{count}} pending speakers with their voiceprint samples AND all their segments. This cannot be undone.
modals.consolidateHint: These pending speakers' centroid similarity ≥ {{threshold}} — likely the same person split apart. Green marks the profile kept after merge (longest audio).
modals.consolidateEmpty: No split speakers or insignificant profiles found
modals.insignificantTitle: Also prune {{count}} insignificant speakers (≤{{matches}} matches & ≤{{seconds}}s, likely ambience/passersby)

ingest.trySubtitle: Transcribe via FunASR and extract voiceprints, returning top candidates
ingest.needFunasr: Configure audiosync_funasr_endpoint in the Audio Sync entity first
ingest.noSpeech: No valid speech detected in the audio
ingest.noCandidate: No candidates (empty library or no voiceprint extracted)

sync.title: Directory auto-sync
sync.noSource: No sync source configured (audiosync_watch_dir or OpenList in the Audio Sync entity)
sync.enableHint: Enable audiosync_watch_enabled in the Audio Sync entity and configure audiosync_watch_dir (NAS mount) or OpenList

injection.title: Context injection
injection.hint: Speaker roster and unread updates are injected into AI context every turn (audio_context_inject)

realtime.hint: Listening — just speak; she will reply with voice (speak during playback to interrupt)
realtime.startFailed: Voice channel failed to start (check mic permission and ASR/TTS config)

chains.hint: Provider priority chain per capability (reorder; first configured handles the call, failures degrade automatically)

generation.defaultsSubtitle: Defaults used when synthesis tools are called without explicit params

placeholders.tts_default_reference_audio: URL or workspace path (clone takes precedence)
placeholders.tts_default_reference_text: Text spoken in the reference audio

descs.tts_default_voice: Preset voice; mutually exclusive with clone reference (reference wins)
descs.tts_default_reference_audio: Reference audio for voice cloning, requires reference text
descs.tts_default_reference_text: Required for cloning: the text spoken in the reference audio
